_note: THE EDITOR-SESSION EVENT PLANE (studio-apps.md §7.1). Subscription is the MANIFEST (`events` on a UI contribution row) — no runtime subscribe verb exists, so an app's event reach is visible at install and can never widen. The HOST is the only publisher (the hub refuses an unknown kind loudly: the closed list is the contract), and delivery is one budgeted ENTRY into the app's own runner, dispatched to the app's declared handler action by the NAMING CONVENTION pinned here: `on` + the event id's dot-segments PascalCased (document.saved → onDocumentSaved). A subscribed event with no matching handler is delivered to nobody, silently — the manifest said the app cares; the linter's opinion belongs there, not in a runtime error. `payloads` pins each kind's REQUIRED payload fields (a publisher may add fields — additive law — and may never drop one within a studioApi major); selection.changed is page-local (the live selection rides the surface's own attr, so it never crosses the SSE lane). Single-runner (the web Studio host). Runner: packages/cli/test/studio-apps-events.test.ts.
